description: Registration facts for a domain from the public RDAP directory: registration date, age in days, expiry, registrar, lock status. No authority score, backlink or spam index: no free public source for those was found (Tranco rank API needs a key; DNS-over-HTTPS was unreachable from the test network). Related tools on this server, for a different need: agent_intel_solana_authority_audit when you need Solana SPL token mint audit from the public Solana RPC: is; agent_intel_typosquat_phishing_domain_radar when you need for a brand domain, builds up to 15 look-alike variants. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

domain.description: Domain name such as wikipedia.org (a full URL is accepted and reduced to its host)
